mapper.select: select member_seq, login_id, nickname, gender, trunc(months_between(sysdate, birth_date) / 12) as age from member where login_id = #{loginId}
select count(*) from member_profile mp join member m on mp.member_seq = m.member_seq where m.login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: insert into member_profile ( member_profile_seq, member_seq, nickname, mbti, job, height, weight, introduction, love_type, hobby, favorite, dislike, drinking, smoking, religion, food_preference, face_type, skin_type, created_at ) values ( seq_member_profile.nextval, #{memberSeq}, #{nickname}, #{mbti}, #{job}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{introduction}, #{loveType}, #{hobby}, #{favorite}, #{dislike}, #{drinking}, #{smoking}, #{religion}, #{foodPreference}, #{faceType}, #{skinType}, sysdate )
mapper.select: select count(*) from ideal_type where login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: insert into ideal_type ( ideal_type_seq, login_id, age_min, age_max, min_height, max_height, body_type, mbti_pref, smoking_pref, drinking_pref, memo, created_at, updated_at ) values ( seq_ideal_type.nextval, #{loginId}, #{ageMin}, #{ageMax}, #{minHeight}, #{maxHeight}, #{bodyType}, #{mbtiPref}, #{smokingPref}, #{drinkingPref}, #{memo}, systimestamp, systimestamp )
mapper.update: update ideal_type set age_min = #{ageMin}, age_max = #{ageMax}, min_height = #{minHeight}, max_height = #{maxHeight}, body_type = #{bodyType}, mbti_pref = #{mbtiPref}, smoking_pref = #{smokingPref}, drinking_pref = #{drinkingPref}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = systimestamp where login_id = #{loginId}
